tools.name: guild_search
tools.description: Search for guild workflow packs by keyword. Searches both local packs and the remote index. Returns matching packs with their metadata (name, problem class, tier, confidence).

query.description: Search query (keywords to match against pack names, descriptions, problem classes). Empty returns all packs.

tools.name: guild_pull
tools.description: Fetch, validate, and store a guild pack locally. Downloads from URI, runs safety scan, and saves to ~/.hermes/guild/. Returns pack metadata and proof gate status.

tools.name: guild_try
tools.description: Preview a guild workflow pack without saving it. Shows pack metadata, phases, proof gates, safety scan results, and trust tier. Use before guild_pull to check if a pack is worth adopting.

tools.name: guild_apply
tools.description: Execute a guild workflow pack with phase tracking. Multi-action: action='start' loads a pulled pack and returns an approval summary; action='checkpoint' logs a phase result (passed/failed); action='complete' finalizes and generates feedback.

pack_name.description: Name of the pack (must be pulled first, for action='start')

task.description: Task description — what you're applying the pack to (for action='start')

session_id.description: Active session ID from guild_apply_start (for checkpoint/complete)

phase_name.description: Phase name to checkpoint, or '__approval__' to approve execution (for action='checkpoint')

evidence.description: Evidence supporting the checkpoint result (optional, for action='checkpoint')

tools.name: guild_publish
tools.description: Publish a guild artifact (workflow pack or feedback) for validation and publishing. Validates proof gates and safety, then creates a GitHub PR. Falls back to local outbox if gh CLI is unavailable.

action.description: Action: 'list' to show available artifacts, 'publish' to publish one

pack_name.description: Name of the pack to publish (for action='publish')

feedback_name.description: Name of the feedback to publish (for action='publish')

path.description: Explicit path to artifact file (for action='publish')

tools.name: guild_keygen
tools.description: Generate a new Ed25519 signing key pair for agent authentication. Saves private key to ~/.hermes/keys/agent-ed25519.key. Returns the hex-encoded public key. Requires pynacl.

force.description: If true, overwrite existing key. Default false.

tools.name: guild_sign
tools.description: Sign a SHA-256 content hash with the agent's Ed25519 private key. Returns a base64-encoded signature. Key must exist (use guild_keygen first).
